packageRules.description: Automerge dependency updates (digest, pin, patch, minor) with no human in the loop. platformAutomerge stays false on purpose: with it on, GitHub merges as soon as the repository's *required* checks pass, and this repository deliberately has none - so a bump would land before the validation that .github/workflows/validate-renovate.yaml runs. With it off, Renovate itself merges on a later run, once the branch carries a green renovate/validate status.
Major updates change defaults and are read by a human, always. Errors and alerts from these changes are not something the cluster should discover on its own.
Vendored upstream operator bundles must move as a whole (image tag + CRDs + KUBEVIRT_VERSION env), so never automerge image bumps inside them
